Maya: Okay team — idea: 'Couch Club' this Friday 8pm PT. Option A: watch The Vast Quiet (docu, 90m). Option B: mini-series binge (2 eps). Option C: book micro-exchange + coffee. Vote with emoji: :popcorn: A, :tv: B, :book: C. Thoughts?
Jon: Love this. I'm team :popcorn: unless we stream something short.
Priya: :book: for me — can we do a 6-page excerpt readout + discuss? low-barrier.
Sam: @Maya I can host a watch party on Teleparty. Free for most shows. Link when decided.
Ruth: If it's A, can someone check if it's on Prime? I have Prime but not HBOMax.
Aria: Trailer: https://youtu.be/abcd1234 — looks cozy. I'd do A or C.
Maya: I'll tally. Current votes: A :popcorn: (Jon, Aria), B :tv: (), C :book: (Priya).
OpsBot: Poll created — react to this thread to cast your vote. Poll closes Fri 6pm PT.
Sam: Also shoutout — free leftover biscotti in kitchen, bring a mug ☕
Ruth: If we end up with C, my rec: 'The Last Librarian' — weird little SF novella, 160 pages.
Jon: Quick question: timezone check — 8pm PT is 11pm ET? late for folks in EU.
Priya: I'm okay with 8pm PT this time.
Maya: Noted. If majority prefers earlier, we'll move it. Also micro-exchange rules: bring one physical book or a 2-paragraph rec if virtual.
Aria: I can do a 2-paragraph rec + slide of 3 favorite lines.
Sam: Vote cast :popcorn: (added).
Ruth: Cast :book: just now.
Maya: Final tally at 6pm Fri — current: A (3), C (2), B (0). I'll post watch link + meetup channel if A wins.
Jon: Excited. Also, karaoke after? :mic: :grin: 
Priya: Haha no but snacks yes.
Maya: Great. Thanks all! See you Friday or we'll swap reading notes Monday. :wave:
